inclusions.text: Motor-boat crossing to New Kalabsha island
inclusions.source: Motor-boat crossing to New Kalabsha island — roughly fifteen minutes across open water with the dam wall to one side.

On the island, the licensed guide moves through the three structures in sequence: Kalabsha first (the largest, the longest visit), then Beit el-Wali (twenty minutes for the painted reliefs), then the Kertassi kiosk at the water's edge for the closing photograph.
